path.description: CSV file path relative to the workspace root, for example data/orders.csv. Absolute paths, '..' and links that leave the root are refused.

delimiter.description: Field separator. auto picks the one that gives the most rows of equal width.

encoding.description: Text encoding. utf-8 also accepts a byte order mark.

has_header.description: true when the first row holds column names. When false, columns are named column_1, column_2 and so on.

columns.description: Profile only these column names. Needed when the file has more than 100 columns.

top_values.description: How many of the most common values to list for each column.

include_values.description: false leaves out common values, examples and the numeric range, and keeps counts, types and shapes. A shape writes each letter of any script as A or a, each digit as 9 and each other character as _, except ASCII punctuation and spaces, which stay visible.

max_rows.description: Read only the first max_rows data rows. The answer then says complete false. Default: every row.
